component_coverage.function: OLED display stack including panel, driver flex, and local stiffeners.
Front impact, scratch, and optical cover layer.
Capacitive touch sensor layer, controller interface, and flex routing.
Primary rigid or rigid-flex board carrying compute, power, storage, radios, connectors, and routing.
Main application processor, accelerator, NPU/GPU blocks, and package substrate.
DRAM or stacked memory packages supporting local AI workloads.
Nonvolatile storage package and controller interface.
Rechargeable lithium-based cell stack, pouch, protection allowance, and tabs.
Thin two-phase heat transport module from compute hotspots to larger surfaces.
In-plane heat spreading film or sheet to distribute local thermal loads.
Temporary thermal buffering material near transient hotspots.
Rear image sensor, lens stack, actuator if used, and local shield or bracket.
Front image sensor and optics for user-facing capture.
Cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GNSS, and diversity antenna structures and feeds.
Rear inductive charging coil, ferrite, shield, and receive losses.
Acoustic transducers, chambers, mesh, and seals.
Microphone capsules, ports, seals, and acoustic routing.
Linear resonant actuator or haptic motor and driver.
External wired power, data connector, receptacle, shield, and local reinforcement.
IMU, proximity, ambient light, magnetometer, barometer, and related small sensors.
Discrete secure element, TPM-like security controller, or hardware root-of-trust package.
Screws, brackets, tapes, adhesives, seals, cushions, and miscellaneous retainers.

blockers.missing_evidence: Completed supplier response templates, controlled drawings, limits, lifecycle/availability, sample terms, and attestations.
blockers.exact_next_action: Authorize supplier outreach using research/rfqs after contact and NDA review; request completed response schemas and source documents.
blockers.fallback: Retain public candidates only as references; do not select components or release CAD.

blockers.missing_evidence: Complete-pack CAD, swelling/tolerances, protection, charge/discharge curves, temperature/cycle limits, safety and shipping documentation.
blockers.exact_next_action: Request a supplier-proposed pack fitting the RFQ envelope and validated charger/system limits; do not prescribe unsupported capacity or charge rate.
blockers.fallback: Use the best supplier-validated capacity fitting the envelope; cap wired charge below 30 W if required; wireless remains removed.

blockers.missing_evidence: Package/ball maps, qualified 128 GB topology, PMIC/rails, reference schematic, power/load steps, software access, and sustained workload telemetry.
blockers.exact_next_action: Obtain the selected platform's NDA-controlled design package and evaluation access for the 128 GB fallback.
blockers.fallback: Use external 128 GB developer systems for workload characterization only; do not claim pocket integration.

blockers.missing_evidence: Selected display module drawing/flex/power and selected storage package/host/power/thermal/lifecycle evidence.
blockers.exact_next_action: Run prepared display and storage RFIs; request EVT-available modules and complete response schemas.
blockers.fallback: Allow supplier-available 7–8.4 inch display variation and modular/external storage; 4 TB internal stays rejected.

blockers.missing_evidence: Released 3D CAD, tolerance/mass/interference review, schematic/netlist/routed ECAD, solver model, EM model, and peer signoff.
blockers.exact_next_action: After supplier packages are verified, authorize detailed CAD/ECAD/solver work and any required paid tools or contractors.
blockers.fallback: Preserve provisional blocking models and 10.2 mm first thickness fallback; do not release hardware.

blockers.missing_evidence: Market/SKU matrix, current lab scope, calibrated tests, accredited reports, certifications/declarations/filings.
blockers.exact_next_action: Select target markets/configurations and engage qualified labs/regulatory counsel after production-intent hardware exists.
blockers.fallback: Defer cellular, remove wireless charging, limit claims/markets, and retain modular development radios.

blockers.missing_evidence: Selected BOM, released designs, authorized build, calibrated setup, raw results, deviations, and correlated models.
blockers.exact_next_action: Authorize procurement/build/energized testing only after the EVT0 prerequisite and safety gates pass.
blockers.fallback: Continue workload characterization on external developer hardware without claiming integrated prototype performance.

blockers.missing_evidence: Completed supplier DFM responses, released process/tooling, pilot authorization, 100-unit records, yield/capability, reliability, compliance, and service results.
blockers.exact_next_action: After verified EVT0, authorize supplier DFM and then the controlled pilot only when G0/G1 pass.
blockers.fallback: Hold production claims and iterate EVT/design/process; do not shrink denominators or hide rework/failures.
